bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
cid=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
test "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true || exit 61
test "$(docker ps --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=gace-createvdobot --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=videobot-poll -q | wc -l)" -eq 1 || exit 62
if docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{range .Config.Env}}{{println .}}{{end}}' | cut -d= -f1 | grep -Eq '^(TELEGRAM_TEST_BOT_TOKEN_FILE|VIDEOBOT_TELEGRAM_TEST_TOKEN_FILE|VIDEOBOT_TEST_BOT_TOKEN_FILE)$'; then echo TELEGRAM_TEST_BOT_TOKEN_DECLARED=YES; else echo TELEGRAM_TEST_BOT_TOKEN_DECLARED=NO; fi
if test -r /run/secrets/videobot_telegram_test_token; then echo HOST_TELEGRAM_TEST_TOKEN_FILE=YES; else echo HOST_TELEGRAM_TEST_TOKEN_FILE=NO; fi
if docker exec "$cid" test -r /run/secrets/videobot_telegram_test_token; then echo CONTAINER_TEST_TOKEN_FILE=YES; else echo CONTAINER_TEST_TOKEN_FILE=NO; fi
docker exec "$cid" node --input-type=module -e 'const r=await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:8766/health");if(r.status!==200)process.exit(1)' || exit 63
echo LIVE_PRODUCTION_BOT_UNCHANGED=PASS
